items.description: Skydance made the announcement Monday. Gunn and Safran will be replaced by Marvel veteran Jeremy Latcham.

items.title: California picks a new insurance commissioner and she's a San Francisco progressive

items.title: Tesla will phase out Cybertruck production next year, Musk says

items.title: SoCal Berry Growers to close six farm locations, lay off hundreds of workers

items.description: In one of the most expensive ballot fights in California history, opponents heavily outspent supporters of a billionaire tax to mostly fund healthcare. On Wednesday, the wealth tax appeared headed for defeat though results on Proposition 40 were too close to call.
